Thanks for the intro. To initiate vendor onboarding we need the following items from Redwood:

1) Completed IRS W-9 (signed, PDF)
2) ACH form with routing/account details OR confirmation we will send a vendor payment portal link
3) Completed vendor contact sheet (name, remit address, tax classification)

Once we receive items 1–3 we will perform vendor verification and send the portal invite (you will receive vendor-portal@tidalhealth.com as the sender). Current processing time is ~7–10 business days from receipt of all items.

If you prefer, send the W-9 directly to vendor-portal@tidalhealth.com and mark the subject: "Redwood Inference — Vendor Setup" so it routes correctly.

Regards,
